description: Byte fixtures for the llama.cpp adapter's embedded chat-template render: chat::render_embedded_template, the model-free half of render_embedded (add_generation_prompt true). Cases with tools null take a tool-less template path (the fallback, or LFM3's and Inkling's template-only render); cases with tools take the tools path, with the definitions in the shape render_with_tools passes for these templates (bare function objects, or the OpenAI wrapper for Inkling). bos_token is absent (suppressed) unless the case models a vocabulary that does not add BOS itself (LFM3), enable_thinking is false unless set, and reasoning_effort is omitted unless set. template is inline text or a file relative to the workspace root. The renders must stay byte-identical.
generator: Captured on master 89400752 (before enable_thinking became Option<bool>) by a throwaway test that called render_embedded_template on each case's inputs and wrote the results with serde_json; the rendered fields were copied in unchanged. The lfm3 cases were added with templates/lfm3.jinja, byte-identical to LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B's chat_template.jinja (revision 40ebe0aa6662c9d40389c2f5d565b6a2c6aebacd), the template embedded in its GGUFs and llama.cpp's models/templates/LFM3.jinja (v0.8.0, 8642541b): their tool-less renders come from Hugging Face transformers' chat-template environment (Jinja2 3.1.6) and match render_embedded_template byte for byte; the tools case is render_embedded_template's own output, because its tool JSON (sorted keys, compact nesting) differs from transformers' json.dumps. Regenerate only for an intended render change. The inkling2 cases were added with templates/inkling2.jinja, byte-identical to thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini's chat_template.jinja (revision 7a67ae2314b44ef05c87fd1d4d311c58aaeb18f6, sha256 53a9035f3255945704b5857657cfb00c1165090c0641c4f782a0cbf268cc16dc), the template embedded in ggml-org/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF and shared by thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Small: all four renders, the tools case included, come from Hugging Face transformers' chat-template environment (Jinja2 3.1.6) and match render_embedded_template byte for byte, since the template asks tojson for sorted keys and compact separators.
